$comment: The Rules contract (docs/playtest-workflow.md), run in block mode by scripts/check-rules-contract.cjs. Only these rules: the advisory title, description and commit checks are .github/review-conventions.json. Keys: README.md "Config reference" in bitswell-hq/review-conventions.

rules.message: Rules grounding must cite rulebook.html#section and explain the connection, or say "Not applicable: <reason and relevant specification>"
Rules grounding references an unknown rulebook section
Rule-bearing files changed: Galactic Reach rules cannot be marked not applicable
Gameplay impact must start with "None:" or "Changed:" and explain the behavior or why it is preserved
Game logic changes require a meaningful update to prototypes/galactic-reach/rulebook.html in the same PR
